text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, meropenem is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 337 vials (22.3 days), Corvale General holds 425 vials (27.9 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 29 vials (11.2 days) of the 1 g/30 mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include meropenem as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: System-wide supply is adequate at East and General. Lakeside inventory is low at 11.2 days and requires replenishment to maintain a minimum 14-day buffer. No national shortage is declared.

Recommended actions:
1. Place a targeted order for Corvale Lakeside from Gland Pharma Limited (plant last inspected VAI 2023-06-27). Approval: Pharmacy buyer.
2. If Gland Pharma Limited cannot fulfill within 5 business days, order from WG Critical Care, LLC. Approval: Pharmacy buyer.
3. If the first two options fail, order from ARMAS PHARMACEUTICALS INC (supplied by Brooks Steriscience Limited, last inspected VAI 2024-11-12). Approval: Pharmacy buyer.
4. Monitor daily usage at all three sites and report any consumption increase above 20% to the P&T Committee. Approval: Pharmacy buyer and P&T Committee chair.

Not recommended: Do not initiate system-wide conservation protocols, formulary alternatives, or allocation restrictions at this time.
